id: title:andrewm4894:swap sonnet 5 for sonnet 5 5 in the scout model picker

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Claude Sonnet 5.5 to the supported model configuration, potentially enabling this model for users if backend support exists.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 updates the SCOUT_MODEL_IDS array to include 'claude-sonnet-5-5', indicating a configuration change to support a new AI model. This is a localized, bounded change. No backend implementation or test execution results are supplied, so the actual benefit or compatibility is not demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based solely on the configuration change. The score does not account for the actual availability or performance of the new model, nor does it account for the lack of supplied backend implementation or test results.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a test file; P1.F2.H1 is the implementation. The implementation hunk P1.F2.H1 changes the model ID from 'claude-sonnet-5' to 'claude-sonnet-5-5'. This could support a backend change adding Claude Sonnet 5.5, but the backend implementation is not supplied. P1.F1.H1 updates the corresponding test assertion. The connection relies on an unobsy
